zh.title: 给模型头的卷发固定发圈
zh.question: 人物用发圈固定模型头上的卷发，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手分工、指间拉伸与穿绕的协调，不要求唯一扎法。
zh.contact: 发圈、发束与手的接触和穿绕应连续，模型头支撑应可解释。
zh.object: 发圈可伸长并回缩，发束可聚拢或弯曲，变化应与双手操作相关。
zh.aftermath: 若松手后发圈收紧或发束回弹，观察保持与释放，不要求全部散发被束住。
zh.unknown: 只有准备发圈，或实际穿绕和固定不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 双手、发圈、假发与模型头支撑整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有固定操作。
固定尝试可辨认，但指间操作与发圈关键穿绕或发束反应严重不符。
拉伸、穿绕或发束聚拢部分合理，同时有影响固定的明显异常。
主要固定、双手协调及发圈和卷发关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际固定可评价，双手、发圈、假发及可见松手后保持或回弹协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Secure a mannequin’s curly wig with a hair tie
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person secures the mannequin’s curls with the hair tie?
en.body: Consider hand roles and coordination of finger stretching and wrapping. No unique tying technique is required.
en.contact: Tie, hair, and hand contact and wrapping should be continuous, with interpretable head support.
en.object: The tie may stretch and retract while hair gathers or bends in relation to hand action.
en.aftermath: If the tie tightens or hair rebounds after release, consider retention and release. All loose strands need not be gathered.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only tie preparation is shown or actual wrapping and fastening cannot be assessed.
scores: The hands, tie, wig, and head support behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no fastening.
An attempt is recognizable, but finger action and key wrapping or hair responses seriously disagree.
Some stretching, wrapping, or gathering is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting fastening.
The main fastening, hand coordination, and tie–curl relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual fastening is assessable, and hands, tie, wig, and visible post-release retention or rebound are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 支撑并整理自己的长发
zh.question: 人物支撑并整理自己的长发，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手分束抓持、手腕与抬臂协调，不要求完成特定辫形。
zh.contact: 手指与发束的接触、交替支撑及相对移动应连续。
zh.object: 发丝可分束、弯曲或交叠，变化应与指间动作相关，原有辫子不自动代表当前编织成功。
zh.aftermath: 若松手或发束下垂，观察重力和剩余编织的保持，不要求头发固定不动。
zh.unknown: 仅展示长发或准备抓取，实际整理不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、双手、发束及头部连接整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有整理。
整理尝试可辨认，但交替抓持与发束关键运动严重不符。
分束、支撑或发丝交叠部分合理，同时有影响整理的明显异常。
主要整理、双手协调及发束支撑和下垂合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际整理可评价，人体、双手、长发及可见松手后状态协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Support and arrange one’s long hair
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person supports and arranges her long hair?
en.body: Consider sectioning grips and wrist–raised-arm coordination. A particular completed braid is not required.
en.contact: Finger contact, alternating support, and relative hair motion should be continuous.
en.object: Strands may section, bend, or overlap in relation to finger action. An existing braid does not establish current braiding success.
en.aftermath: If grip releases or hair hangs, consider gravity and retention of existing interweaving. Immobile hair is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only display or grasp preparation is shown and actual arranging cannot be assessed.
scores: The person, hands, strands, and head attachment behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no arranging.
An attempt is recognizable, but alternating grip and key hair motion seriously disagree.
Some sectioning, support, or overlap is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting arranging.
The main arranging, hand coordination, hair support, and hanging are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual arranging is assessable, and the person, hands, long hair, and visible post-release state are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 从头发中取下发卷
zh.question: 人物从头发中取下带夹子的发卷，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察一手控制发卷或夹子、另一手支撑发束及手腕协调。
zh.contact: 夹子释放、发卷转动或抽离应与手部操作相关，发束与发卷的接触应连续。
zh.object: 头发可逐步松开并保留或改变弯曲，不要求立刻形成固定卷度。
zh.aftermath: 若发卷离开或发束落下，观察支撑解除与重力，不要求头发完全恢复直线。
zh.unknown: 只有准备碰发卷，或实际解夹抽离不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、发卷、夹子与发束关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有取卷操作。
取卷尝试可辨认，但双手控制与夹子或发束关键释放严重不符。
解夹、转动或发束松开部分合理，同时有影响取卷的明显异常。
主要取卷、人体协调及发卷和发束释放合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际取卷可评价，双手、夹子、发卷、头发及可见下垂或后续保持协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Remove a clipped roller from the hair
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person removes the clipped roller from her hair?
en.body: Consider one hand controlling the roller or clip and the other supporting the section, with wrist coordination.
en.contact: Clip release, roller rotation, or withdrawal should relate to hand action, with continuous hair–roller contact.
en.object: Hair may gradually unwind and retain or change curvature. A fixed immediate curl is not required.
en.aftermath: If the roller leaves or hair falls, consider support release and gravity. Full straightening is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only reaching preparation is shown or actual unclipping and withdrawal cannot be assessed.
scores: The person, roller, clip, and hair behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no roller-removal action.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand control and key clip or hair release seriously disagree.
Some unclipping, rotation, or unwinding is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting removal.
The main removal, body coordination, and roller–hair release are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual removal is assessable, and hands, clip, roller, hair, and visible hanging or subsequent retention are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 用环形发圈调整马尾
zh.question: 人物用环形发圈调整马尾，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察抬臂、双手分工和指间拉伸扭转的协调，不要求固定扎圈次数。
zh.contact: 发圈与手指及发束的穿绕应连续，头发与头部连接应可解释。
zh.object: 发圈可伸长回缩，马尾可聚拢或松开，变化应与操作相关。
zh.aftermath: 若手松开或发圈收紧，观察发束保持及自然下垂，不要求马尾完全无散发。
zh.unknown: 仅举圈准备，实际穿绕或调整不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、发圈、马尾与头部关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有调整。
调整尝试可辨认，但双手拉扭与发圈关键穿绕或马尾反应严重不符。
抬臂、穿绕或聚拢部分合理，同时有影响调整的明显异常。
主要调整、双手协调及发圈马尾关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际调整可评价，人体、发圈、马尾及可见松手后保持或下垂协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Adjust a ponytail with a ring-shaped hair tie
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person adjusts the ponytail with the ring-shaped tie?
en.body: Consider raised arms, hand roles, and finger stretching and twisting. No fixed wrap count is required.
en.contact: Wrapping around fingers and hair should be continuous, with interpretable attachment to the head.
en.object: The tie may stretch and retract, and the ponytail may gather or loosen in relation to operation.
en.aftermath: If hands release or the tie tightens, consider retention and natural hanging. A perfectly strand-free ponytail is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only tie preparation is shown and actual wrapping or adjustment cannot be assessed.
scores: The person, tie, ponytail, and head behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no adjustment.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand stretching or twisting and key wrapping or ponytail responses seriously disagree.
Some raised-arm action, wrapping, or gathering is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting adjustment.
The main adjustment, hand coordination, and tie–ponytail relation are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual adjustment is assessable, and the person, tie, ponytail, and visible post-release retention or hanging are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 用发刷梳理模型头卷发
zh.question: 人物用发刷梳理模型头的卷曲假发，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察持刷、另一手控制发束或模型头及手臂导向协调。
zh.contact: 刷齿进入和离开发束的运动应与手部操作对应，模型头支撑应连续。
zh.object: 发束可受牵拉、分开或更顺，不要求一遍完全去除缠结或卷曲。
zh.aftermath: 若刷子离开或发束回弹，观察释放与重力，不要求假发脱落。
zh.unknown: 仅持刷准备，实际刷齿与发束交互不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、发刷、假发和模型头整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有梳理。
梳理尝试可辨认，但刷的导向与发束关键移动或支撑严重不符。
握刷、梳齿接触或发束分开部分合理，同时有影响梳理的明显异常。
主要梳理、人体协调及发束和模型头支撑合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际梳理可评价，人体、发刷、假发及可见回弹或后续垂落协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Brush a mannequin’s curly wig
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person brushes the mannequin’s curly wig?
en.body: Consider brush grip, the other hand controlling hair or head, and arm guidance.
en.contact: Teeth entering and leaving the hair should correspond to hand action, with continuous head support.
en.object: Hair may tension, separate, or become smoother. Fully removing tangles or curls in one pass is not required.
en.aftermath: If the brush withdraws or hair rebounds, consider release and gravity. Wig detachment is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only brush preparation is shown and actual tooth–hair interaction cannot be assessed.

Some grip, tooth contact, or section separation is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting brushing.
The main brushing, body coordination, hair, and head support are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual brushing is assessable, and the person, brush, wig, and visible rebound or subsequent hanging are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 向已盘起的头发喷发胶
zh.question: 人物向已盘起的头发喷发胶，整体交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察握罐、手指按压及手腕对准发髻的协调，不要求特定表情。
zh.contact: 喷嘴方向、喷出物和受喷头发应在位置与时序上对应，罐体不必接触头发。
zh.object: 头发可保持发型或轻微移动，不要求立刻变形或完全湿透。
zh.aftermath: 若喷雾飘散、停喷或手移开，观察来源和延续，不要求喷雾全部附着。
zh.unknown: 仅拿罐对准头发，实际喷出和受喷区域不足以评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、喷罐、喷雾和头发关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有喷发胶。
喷涂尝试可辨认，但手部按压、喷嘴方向与关键头发或雾滴反应严重不符。
握罐、喷出或头发响应部分合理，同时有影响喷涂的明显异常。
主要喷涂、人体协调及喷雾与发髻关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际喷涂可评价，人体、喷罐、头发及可见雾滴后续运动协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Apply hairspray to styled hair
en.question: How physically plausible is the interaction as the person applies hairspray to the styled bun?
en.body: Consider can grip, finger pressing, and wrist alignment with the bun. No particular expression is required.
en.contact: Nozzle direction, output, and receiving hair should correspond in position and time. Can–hair contact is not required.
en.object: Hair may retain its style or move slightly. Immediate deformation or complete soaking is not required.
en.aftermath: If mist drifts, output stops, or the hand withdraws, consider source and continuation. All spray need not deposit.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the can is only aimed and actual output and receiving region cannot be assessed.
